title: The Meeting (The Progress of Love)
source: The Frick Collection, New York (public domain). Wikimedia Commons: Jean-Honoré Fragonard - Les Progrès de l'amour - Le rendez-vous - Google Art Project.jpg
caption: A secret date in the garden. She just heard something. #arthistory #lovestory #painting #oilpainting #art
_verify: Commissioned by Madame du Barry for her pavilion at Louveciennes, 1771; returned to the artist; now Frick Collection (Wikipedia EN, The Progress of Love).
The reason du Barry returned them is debated (style change to Neoclassicism is the usual guess).
Fragonard installed them in Grasse around 1790 with extra panels: general history, not re-checked today.
NO NUDITY: the garden statue has small sculpted figures; no zoom on the statue.

slides.headline: A secret date. Someone is coming.
A royal order
slides.text: 1771. Madame du Barry, the French king's mistress, orders a series of paintings about falling in love. This one is the secret meeting.

slides.headline: Over the wall
slides.text: A young man has just climbed over the garden wall on a ladder. He is not supposed to be here at all.

slides.headline: Her look
slides.text: She stops him with one hand and turns to look behind her. Has someone heard them? Is someone coming?

slides.headline: The garden
slides.text: Fragonard hides them in wild trees and tall shrubs, a garden made for secrets. Every branch seems to tremble with their nerves.

slides.headline: The roses
slides.text: Roses spill over everything at their feet, the classic flower of love. Even the garden seems to be on the lovers' side.

slides.headline: Sent back
slides.text: But Madame du Barry sent the paintings back to Fragonard. Historians still argue why. Perhaps they suddenly looked old-fashioned.

slides.headline: A second life
slides.text: Fragonard kept them for twenty years, then added more panels to finish a room of his own. Today they hang in New York.

slides.headline: Stay or run?
slides.text: One more step and they are caught. If you were him, would you stay for one kiss, or run back over the wall?
